question: Which existing observations and tools can support a restricted Indus reading, and what independent evidence is missing?
outcome: Reviewed the 101-entry baseline and four papers. All 66 Harappa tablet faces and 353 of 355 nominated numerical-class rows fall outside the principal length filter. Lothal repeated-string/contact records support a bounded physical-use test. Eight capacity rows supply no eligible independent quantity target. Object-specific count, operation or referent observations remain the key inputs for a restricted reading.
challenge: Graphic prediction, generated correspondence recovery, fitted quantities and historical interpretation have different input requirements; short source-defined records were largely absent from the main predictor's population.
remedy: Map all entries to seventeen capability families, inventory actual schemas/images/source frames, retain original semantic proposals separately, calculate descriptive compatibility and name specimen-specific acquisition and validation targets.
retry_when: A named independent quantity, referent, original source packet, corrected specimen join or historically justified reference changes the readiness of a specific test. Use the named prior audit before repeating a capability experiment.
